instruction: Buy everything on my amazon wishlist, and have it delivered to my home address.
notes: Single-app task (amazon) plus supervisor. The wish list is modeled as three placeholder products with per-product quantities (static wishlist-entry facts); the real number of entries is read at runtime from amazon.show_wish_list and the problem's product/quantity/count objects should be instantiated accordingly. Because PDDL without quantified/conditional effects cannot express 'all wish-list items are in the cart', a discrete counter (count-0..count-3, count-next, wishlist-size) tracks how many wish-list products have been moved; place_order requires the counter to equal the wish-list size, so (order-placed) is true exactly when one order containing every wish-list product (with its wish-list quantity) has been placed to the address named Home. clear_cart is called once before any move so the order contains only wish-list products (CartEntry changes are ignored by the evaluation; wish-list entries are removed by the move API, matching the expected WishListEntry change). Addresses are only read (show_addresses), never added/updated/deleted. Order confirmation email/receipt side effects are caused by place_order itself and need no modeling. No answer is required, so complete_task takes no parameters.
